photos.desc: Matt Wedel at Alex Pritchard’s booth at DinoCon 2025, with his mounted Aquilops skeleton.
Life restoration of Aquilops americanus being handled by a human.
Cloverly formation environment with Gobiconodon pursuing juvenile Aquilops while adults attempt to protect them.
The holotype skull of Aquilops americanus (OMNH 34557), an early ceratopsian from Montana. Displayed at the Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History.
Skull and lower jaw of Aquilops , in my hand for scale.
A reconstructed skull model of Aquilops americanus , an early ceratopsian from Montana. Displayed at the Sam Noble Oklahoma Museum of Natural History.
